items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met him on the road a lot.

ctx.x: Big fat guy. I met him on the road a lot.

I want to say Ben Webster, but Ben wasn’t a big fat guy in those days. Big fat guy? It sounds like he should have been in Basie’s band. I’m blank right now. But a lot of people went through that school. You – it’s sort of setting the stage, but also going back. I’m seeing a kid who’s seeing the riverboat bands. Those bands used to have some good drummers. Who were some of the bands that – can you recall any of the bands that you used to see coming up the river there?
I used to know the name of the drummer, because I was only interested in the drummer.
